subject: SWC 2026: co-branded workshop, signage, and SOW clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@swc-events.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SWC 2026 — draft SOW + co-branded workshop request
Attachments: SWC2026_SOW_Redwood_v3.pdf

Rishi — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation I attached the updated SOW (v3) that reflects the 10x10 demo pod, one 45-minute speaking slot (plenary track), and the co-branded half-day workshop on Thursday morning. A few open items before we can finalize:

- Workshop room assignment and max capacity (we have options in Hall B breakout rooms)
- Placement and size for sponsor directional signage (hallway + 1x stage banner)
- Whether Redwood can supply a sponsored breakout facilitator (table for 8 + AV) or prefer venue staff
- Final logo files per the guidelines (see attached)

Can you confirm whether the plenary slot can be moved to a 30-min fireside instead of 45, and whether the co-branded workshop requires an extra fee for room A/B? I can loop in venue ops once we have firm preferences.

Best,
Elena
Event Director — Southwest Cloud Conference
SWC Events

Elena — thanks, I reviewed v3 and appreciate the quick update. High-level notes from Redwood:

1) Speaking slot: we prefer a 30-minute fireside (shorter + more focused). If the package price changes with the shorter slot, please update the SOW and highlight delta.
2) Workshop: Redwood will run a 3-hour co-branded workshop (Thursday 9–12). We need a room with seating for 60 and two breakout tables for hands-on demos. From the floorplan you sent, Hall B rooms B2/B3 look feasible — attaching for ops.
3) Signage: we need a 2m x 1m stage banner and 2 x 24" directional signs in the hall. Also requesting a small co-branded wall (logo only) in the workshop entrance. Please confirm if these are included or billable.
4) Staffing: Redwood will provide a facilitator and two engineers. No venue staff needed unless AV support is separate.

Kimberly, can you confirm whether we have any constraints on workshop logistics or AV budget? Lauren/Marissa — FYI for sponsorship package and potential add-on pricing.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, Elena Morales <elena@swc-events.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWC 2026 — workshop room/capacity and AV notes
Attachments: logo_guidelines.pdf

Elena / team — quick ops note after reviewing Hall B floorplan:

- B2/B3 combined will support 60 pax with classroom seating and AV. We recommend the vendor provide a breakout table configuration 8-6-6 (3 tables) for hands-on demo stations.
- Venue charges an additional $1,200 for room reconfiguration between 08:30–09:00 (same morning) — so either we accept the fee or schedule the workshop to start at 09:30 to avoid reconfig.
- AV: in-house package includes projector + lav mic. If Redwood requires a dedicated AV tech for sound checks and mics during an interactive workshop, that's an extra $450/day.
- Signage: venue can supply the directional signs but stage banner and wall cling are sponsor-supplied (we can order production; estimate below).

Estimated incremental fees if Redwood pays: room reconfig $1,200 + AV tech $450 + production for stage banner and wall cling ~$950 = $2,600. If SWC covers directional signs only, that reduces to ~$1,650.

Lauren — please add this to the commercial worksheet so we can propose two options (venue-covered vs sponsor-covered).

Kimberly Park
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acmecloud.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, Elena Morales <elena@swc-events.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWC 2026 — workshop room/capacity and AV notes

Rishi — quick note from Acme: budget is tight on this Q. Two asks on our side: (1) Can the plenary be a 20–30 minute fireside (we prefer 30) — ok with reduced length; (2) can Redwood limit workshop attendee cap to 45 (we'll promote heavily but cap to ensure quality) — if you can commit to 45 we can absorb the room reconfig fee; otherwise we'll need Redwood to sponsor the reconfig.

Also, we want a small branded kiosk (36" tall x 3ft wide) near the demo corridor in lieu of the wall cling. If the organizer can approve placement, Acme will cover production but needs the footprint and install window.

We can approve SOW v3 provided the signage approach and final run-of-show reflects the reduced workshop cap and the 30-minute fireside. We want DocuSign by EOD Monday (20 Sep) to lock in invoice timing.

Thanks,
Tom Briggs
Head of Partnerships | Acme Cloud

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@swc-events.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acmecloud.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SWC 2026 — final asks and next steps

Elena / Tom — thanks for the quick clarifications. Summary / action items so we can finalize the SOW and get DocuSign: 

1) Speaking slot: confirm 30-minute fireside (plenary) — REDWOOD agrees. Update SOW pricing to reflect shorter slot (Elena, please show the delta).
2) Workshop: Redwood will run a co-branded workshop capped at 45 attendees. We accept venue covering room reconfig fee in exchange for the reduced cap. Please update SOW to show cap and start time 09:30–12:00.
3) AV and staffing: Redwood will bring 2 engineers and one facilitator; venue will supply standard AV (projector + lav). We will not request dedicated AV tech initially; if sound issues arise we'll escalate.
4) Signage: Acme will cover kiosk production (Tom) and SWC will place it near demo corridor. Redwood will supply stage banner (2m x 1m) and pay for production if needed — please include production estimate line item if vendor charges apply.
5) Deliverables: please attach final floorplan and run-of-show with load-in windows. We need DocuSign link and net-30 invoice terms called out.

Elena — can you circulate SOW v4 with the above changes by EOD Friday (17 Sep) so Tom can sign and we can route to finance? Note the DocuSign deadline Tom requested (EOD 20 Sep) — tight but doable if we get v4 quickly.

I'll prepare a one-page sponsor addendum summarizing signage and workshop cap for internal approvals and attach to the deal in HubSpot. Lauren/Marissa — please prepare the addendum and cost worksheet.

Thanks all — will stand by for v4.

—Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
